label: SYNTHETIC — NOT REAL MALWARE
title: Bundle injection, postinstall hook and hostile archive entries
description: A fabricated npm tarball whose dist bundle has a valid source map for the original code but carries appended, unmapped code that posts NPM/GitHub tokens to a .invalid host. package.json gained a postinstall hook running a package-only script, and the archive contains a path-traversal entry and an escaping symlink (both rejected by the safe extractor).
